scope: Exact production point generators and production chunk shapes on the motivating 200-arm/1001-site/5-anchor workload; excludes evaluator, TreeTN, memo and topology construction. No end-to-end interpolation or runtime claim.
primary_observation: whole-process peak RSS in KiB from GNU time, including dimensions, sides, anchors and checksum; median and range per arm
correctness: 30877 points in each cell and identical whole ordered-stream checksum in all cells; prior small exhaustive production tests establish order and distinctness
profile: rustc opt-level=3 debuginfo=0; no target-cpu override; standard library only, no numerical provider
hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 6900HX, 8 physical / 16 logical CPUs, Linux/WSL
affinity: process on CPU 8; ai-run exclusive measurement CPUs 8-15; observer on 0-7
validity: all processes CLEAN; if contaminated rerun the complete six-cell matrix once, retaining both attempts; no selective retries or omitted failures
acceptance: descriptive RSS observation requested in review; no new runtime or end-to-end performance gate; all correctness checks required
